_comment: Canonical dinas codes RDT can route a transaction TO (dinas_target). Corrected 29 Jul 2026 (project owner): the previous list was a SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER — literally 'T' + every letter A-U sequentially, guessed before the real org structure was available, not GMF's actual GH-level roster. Replaced with the real 21-GH structure from struktur-dinas-gmf.png (project owner supplied): TG/TK/TO/TT never existed as real dinas (dropped); TV/TX/TZ/DFR are real GH units that were simply missing (added) — DFR (Management Risk GH) intentionally doesn't follow the 'T+letter' shape, this list has no length/prefix assumption so that's fine. 'Corp' stays as the separate no-dedicated-PIC catch-all bucket (REQ-RDT-AUTH-04) — unrelated to the org chart, unchanged. Deliberately does NOT include 'TAB' — that's the admin division running RDT itself, not an operational dinas that can receive a repost transaction (backend/sql/schema.sql's comment on rdt.dinas is explicit that TAB has no row there on purpose, so a dinas_target of 'TAB' fails the transactions_dinas_target_fkey constraint outright). 'TAB people confirm it' just means role TAB (which can act on ANY dinas via requireDinasAccess) — it does NOT mean the target value itself becomes 'TAB'. Used by excelParser.js so an exact code resolves even with no mapping.seed.json entry. 'TMM' added 31 Jul 2026 (project owner correction, superseding the 28 Jul 'GMF-wide sub-dinas suffix convention' theory): TMM is its OWN dinas with its own repost business, NOT a sub-unit of TM reachable via a generic code+suffix guess — explicitly reasserted TAB-wide, so no logic anywhere should ever again derive a 2-letter code by truncating a 3-letter one and treat them as the same dinas (see excelParser.js's resolveSubDinasCode, which still exists for other legitimate cases but is never reached for 'TMM' now that it's an exact-match roster entry).
